list_line_items.title: List line items
list_line_items.description: List the advertiser's active line items (current month unless a date range is given) with order, placements, paused/ratified flags, goal unit and quantity, unit cost, budget and scheduled start/end. Use it to find line item ids; for delivery numbers use get_daily_stats or get_creative_stats.

start_date.description: First day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-16. Defaults to the current month.

end_date.description: Last day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-30.

type.description: Set to `csv` to get a CSV document instead of a JSON array.

output.description: Every matching line item: lineitem_id, lineitem_name, order_id, order_name, placements, paused, goal_unit, goal_quantity, unit_cost, ratified, budget, notes, scheduled_start(_iso), scheduled_end(_iso). No pagination.

get_daily_stats.title: Get daily line item stats
get_daily_stats.description: Get impressions, clicks, CTR and spend per line item per day for the advertiser's active line items (current month unless a date range is given). Use get_creative_daily_stats for a per-creative breakdown.

lineitem_id.description: Only this line item. Line item ids come from list_line_items or the buy.buysellads.com app, e.g. 11192.

start_date.description: First day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-16. Defaults to the current month.

end_date.description: Last day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-30.

type.description: Set to `csv` to get a CSV document instead of a JSON array.

output.description: One row per line item per date: lineitem_id, lineitem_name, order_id, order_name, placements, date, impressions, clicks, ctr, spend, notes.

get_creative_stats.title: Get creative stats
get_creative_stats.description: Get totals per creative across the advertiser's line items (current month unless a date range is given): impressions, clicks, CTR, spend, rotation weight, click-through link and creative assets. Use get_creative_daily_stats for the same numbers split by day.

lineitem_id.description: Only this line item. Line item ids come from list_line_items or the buy.buysellads.com app, e.g. 11192.

start_date.description: First day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-16. Defaults to the current month.

end_date.description: Last day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-30.

type.description: Set to `csv` to get a CSV document instead of a JSON array.

output.description: One row per creative: order and line item ids/names, creative_id, link, weight, impressions, clicks, ctr, spend, plus format-specific fields such as image, small_image, description, company_tagline, tracking_pixel.

get_creative_daily_stats.title: Get creative daily stats
get_creative_daily_stats.description: Get impressions, clicks, CTR and spend per creative per day across the advertiser's line items (current month unless a date range is given). Use get_creative_stats for period totals per creative.

lineitem_id.description: Only this line item. Line item ids come from list_line_items or the buy.buysellads.com app, e.g. 11192.

start_date.description: First day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-16. Defaults to the current month.

end_date.description: Last day to include, yyyy-mm-dd (UTC), e.g. 2024-01-30.

type.description: Set to `csv` to get a CSV document instead of a JSON array.

output.description: One row per creative per date: order and line item ids/names, creative_id, date, link, weight, impressions, clicks, ctr, spend, plus format-specific creative fields.
